subject: Post-call: MAP & preflight checklist for POC environment (VPC / SAML / KMS)
snippet: Recap + MAP draft with milestone owners and required infra deps (VPC peering, IP allowlists, SAML/KMS)
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Emma Gray <emma@nimbledata.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T15:12:00Z
Subject: Post-call: MAP & preflight checklist for POC environment (VPC / SAML / KMS)

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciated the deep-dive on your ingestion volume and the compliance constraints. Per our call, I attached an initial MAP worksheet and a simple network diagram that maps the infra pieces we'll need to get the POC running inside your VPC. Key items we agreed to capture:

- Milestones: environment provisioning, connectivity, identity, secrets access, smoke tests, validation.
- Dependencies: VPC peering, static IP allowlist for our egress, SAML configuration for SSO, KMS/HSM access pattern for secrets.
- Target close for the POC kickoff: 2027-01-10 (tentative) — we can tighten once your infra team confirms timelines.

Action items I captured from today's conversation (please confirm or correct):
1) Nimble: open ticket with NetOps for VPC peering and provide preferred VPC / CIDR and contact. Owner: Emma. ETA: 2026-12-03
2) Nimble: confirm SAML IdP metadata and test SP endpoints (we only need basic attributes: NameID, email). Owner: Tom. ETA: 2026-12-06
3) Redwood (Karthik): produce IP ranges and recommended firewall rules for allowlisting; provide ephemeral IP guidance for burst traffic. ETA: 2026-11-30
4) Redwood (Rishi): outline KMS requirement modes (bring-your-own-key vs Redwood-managed) and sample key-policy. ETA: 2026-12-02

Attachments: [Attachment: nimble-map-draft.xlsx (xlsx)], [Attachment: network-diagram.png (png)]

If those owners and dates look good, I'll update the MAP and send a cleaned version by Monday. Shortest path to POC is to prioritize VPC peering + IP allowlist, then SAML, then KMS access (we can run a limited proof without KMS if you prefer a delayed key rotation integration).

Thanks — r

Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai
From: Emma Gray <emma@nimbledata.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Chen <tom.chen@nimbledata.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T08:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP & preflight checklist for POC environment (VPC / SAML / KMS)

Thanks Rachel — this looks great and aligns with our internal notes. A couple clarifications from our side:

- NetOps will need a small RFC. I'll raise that today and include our VPC IDs and primary CIDR. Expect acceptance/approval by 2026-12-02.
- For SAML: we use Okta. I can export the metadata and share it with Karthik by 2026-12-01. We are OK with the minimal attribute set for the initial POC.
- Regarding KMS: we prefer BYOK for production but are open to Redwood-managed keys for the POC if it reduces friction.

Two internal asks:
1) Can Karthik confirm whether the POC will require any inbound connections to our VPC or if all traffic is outbound from Redwood? That affects the peering and NAT egress architecture.
2) Tom will test an egress IP from a dev pod once you send the IP ranges.

I'll confirm owners and update your MAP sheet once the RFC is in. Appreciate the practicable timeline.

—Emma
Head of Cloud Engineering | NimbleData Inc.
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Gray <emma@nimbledata.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T11:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP & preflight checklist for POC environment (VPC / SAML / KMS)

Quick technical notes from our side (adding to the MAP doc):

- Connectivity: Redwood initiates outbound TLS connections to your VPC via peered endpoints. For most customers we do not require inbound ports open. If you prefer a private link-style setup we can discuss but that adds time.
- IP allowlist: attached is the recommended list of small /24s we'll use for the POC (we may use ephemeral egress but will give a static NAT block). If you need a single IP, we can allocate a static NAT for the first phase. See network-diagram.png for placement.
- SAML: Okta metadata should be fine. We ask for an SP-initiated flow for first-pass SSO; NameID=email and groups optional. If you need SCIM for provisioning that's a follow-up.
- KMS: For BYOK we need a cross-account grant on the key allowing Redwood's service principal to Decrypt/Encrypt for the specific key IDs. For an easier POC path we can use Redwood-managed keys and provide audit logs.

I'll update the MAP with the exact port/IP table and flag the items that block the smoke test. Attaching a short checklist I use for preflight.

[Attachment: preflight-checklist.txt (txt)]

Thanks,
Karthik
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Emma Gray <emma@nimbledata.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP & preflight checklist for POC environment (VPC / SAML / KMS)

Great — thanks Emma and Karthik. I've updated the MAP with the confirmed owners and tightened ETA windows based on your notes. Summary of updated milestones and owners (finalize by 2026-12-06 so we can hit POC kickoff target):

- RFC & VPC peering: Owner = Emma Gray (Nimble) — provide VPC IDs and approval ticket by 2026-12-02
- IP allowlist (POC NAT block): Owner = Karthik Iyer (Redwood) — deliver IPs and firewall guidance by 2026-11-30 (already in progress)
- SAML metadata & test: Owner = Tom Chen (Nimble) — share Okta metadata and run SP-initiated test by 2026-12-06
- KMS access mode & sample grant: Owner = Rishi Malhotra (Redwood) + Nimble SecOps — finalize BYOK vs RMK decision by 2026-12-08
- Smoke tests & validation script: Owner = Redwood (Karthik) / Nimble (Tom) — run targeted smoke tests 2026-12-09 to 2026-12-11

Open questions for Nimble before I finalize the doc:
1) Confirm whether NetOps requires inbound ports or strictly egress-only. (Emma, Tom)
2) Confirm preferred contact for KMS cross-account grants (name and email).

Next steps: I'll publish the cleaned MAP workbook and link in this thread tomorrow, and schedule a 30-min tech-preflight call (Karthik + Tom) for 2026-12-01. Please reply to confirm the owners/date windows or flag changes inline.

Best,
Rachel
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
